LCS Backbone (A, B, C)
Sections A, B, C align across
all three sides in monotonic
order, forming the primary
skeleton of the merge.
Weaker Alignment (D)
D aligns between Base and
Right only, because Left
edited D into F.
Intra-File Move (E)
E is present on all sides, but
moved forward on Right.
Aligning it would disrupt B
and C, so it is not in the LCS.
Longest Common Subsequence of all three sides: [ A, B, C ]
(Extended with weaker two-sided alignments: [ A, B, C, D ])
